description: This file defines the Transaction class, which models a purchase transaction with fields for item ID, user ID, and a nonce, including methods for serialization, equality checks, and hashing.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Represents a purchase transaction, encapsulating item ID, user ID, and a nonce, with methods for serialization and equality comparison.

methods.name: Transaction
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transaction with user ID, item ID, and client nonce.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the transaction.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Serializes the transaction's data fields into a byte array for transmission or storage.

methods.name: equals

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on item ID, user ID, and nonce.
